SELECT h.quotation_id AS quotationId, h.quotation_no AS quotationNo, h.quotation_dt AS quotationDt, h.submit_dt AS submitDt, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.customer_reference AS customerReference, h.incoterms, h.payment_term AS paymentTerm, h.valid_term AS validTerm, h.currency_code AS currencyCode, h.remark, h.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, h.vat_amt AS vatAmt, h.total_amt AS totalAmt, h.created_by AS createdBy, d.quotation_detail_id AS quotationDetailId, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, d.material_code AS materialCode, d.material_name AS materialName, d.material_spec AS materialSpec, d.unit, d.quotation_qty AS quotationQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.line_amt AS lineAmt, d.remark AS detailRemark FROM tb_sales_quotation_hd h JOIN tb_sales_quotation_dt d ON d.quotation_id = h.quotation_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.quotation_dt >= #{quotationDtFrom,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler} AND h.quotation_dt <= #{quotationDtTo,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler} AND h.submit_dt >= #{submitDtFrom,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler} AND h.submit_dt <= #{submitDtTo,jdbcType=DATE,typeHandler=egovframework.com.cmm.LocalDateDateTypeHandler} AND h.quotation_no ILIKE '%' || #{quotationNo} || '%' AND (c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{customerKeyword} || '%' OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{customerKeyword} || '%') AND d.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%'
AND (h.quotation_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY h.quotation_dt DESC, h.quotation_id DESC, d.line_no
